Workload_Assumptions.Target_Workload: Enterprise Copilot Cluster Under 2.2x Flash Traffic Surge (320 Incoming RPS vs. 160 RPS Primary 70B Capacity, TTFT SLA <= 800ms)

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: Unbounded FIFO Waiting Queue + Blind Client Exponential Retry Storm (No Deadline Propagation)
Configuration_Matrix.Overload_Strategy: Queue All 320 RPS in Memory; Execute Already-Timed-Out Requests (`Zombie Prefills`)
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Catastrophic anti-pattern: a 2x traffic spike collapses goodput to 8.8% via zombie queue buildup

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: Static RPS Token-Bucket Rate Limiter (Blind to Prompt Token Length & KV Cache Watermark)
Configuration_Matrix.Overload_Strategy: Cap at Fixed 160 RPS Regardless of Whether Requests Are 500-Token or 32K-Token Prompts
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Basic API gateway protection, but fails when average prompt length shifts during RAG spikes

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: Predictive Queued-Prefill-Token & KV-Watermark (`85%`) Hard `429` Load Shedding + Deadline Drop
Configuration_Matrix.Overload_Strategy: Reject Excess Traffic When `Est_Queue_TTFT > 600ms` or `KV_Usage > 85%`; Drop Expired Deadlines
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Protects primary 70B cluster at 95% Goodput, but rejects the other 52.5% of surge users with HTTP 429

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: Predictive TTFT & KV-Watermark Admission Control + Graceful Degradation (`70B -> 8B/32B-FP8` Overflow + Max-Tokens Trim) + LIFO/Priority Queue
Configuration_Matrix.Overload_Strategy: Serve 155 RPS on Primary 70B + Route 158 Overflow RPS to High-Speed 8B/32B Fallback Pool with Context Compression
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Production standard for high-availability enterprise Copilots (22x higher Goodput than unbounded queue under 2.2x surge)
